tools.name: channels
tools.title: Fetch channels
tools.description:
Fetch the list of channels from Saleor.

This tools retrieves the list of channels. For each channel it returns information
such as: ID, name, slug, currency code, default country, whether the channel is
active, and the list of warehouses.

tools.name: customers
tools.title: Fetch customers
tools.description:
Fetch list of customers from Saleor GraphQL API.

This tool retrieves customer information such as: ID, active status, language code,
last login, date joined, and default shipping/billing address country.

first.description: Number of customers to fetch (max 100 per request)

after.description: Cursor for pagination - fetch customers after this cursor

tools.name: orders
tools.title: Fetch orders
tools.description:
Fetch list of orders from Saleor GraphQL API.

This tool retrieves the list of orders. For each order it returns information such
as: ID, number, status, creation date, last update date, payment status, total
amount, shipping and billing address country, order lines which include:
quantity, product SKU, variant name, product ID, product name, unit price.

first.description: Number of orders to fetch (max 100 per request)

after.description: Cursor for pagination - fetch orders after this cursor

filter.description: Filter and search orders by specific criteria

tools.name: order_count
tools.title: Fetch orders count
tools.description:
Fetch total count of orders from Saleor GraphQL API.

This tool retrieves the total count of orders based on the provided filter criteria.

filter.description: Filter and search orders by specific criteria

tools.name: products
tools.title: Fetch products
tools.description:
Fetch list of products from Saleor GraphQL API.

This tool retrieves product information such as: ID, name, slug, external reference,
product type, category, date of creation, date of last update, and pricing.

Products are channel-aware, meaning that their availability and pricing can vary
based on the specified channel. If a channel is provided, the tool will fetch
product data specific to that channel. Otherwise, it will return general product
data.

first.description: Number of products to fetch (max 100 per request)

after.description: Cursor for pagination - fetch products after this cursor

channel.description: Slug of a channel for which the data should be returned. If not provided, general product data is returned.

tools.name: stocks
tools.title: Fetch stocks
tools.description:
Fetch list of stocks from Saleor GraphQL API.

This tool retrieves stock information such as: ID, quantity, allocated quantity,
warehouse information, and associated product variant details.

first.description: Number of stocks to fetch (max 100 per request)

after.description: Cursor for pagination - fetch stocks after this cursor

tools.name: warehouse_details
tools.title: Fetch warehouse details
tools.description:
Fetch warehouse details from Saleor GraphQL API.

This tool retrieves detailed warehouse information including: ID, name, slug,
address details, click and collect options, associated shipping zones with
their channels and countries, and metadata.

id.description: ID of the warehouse to fetch details for

tools.name: current_domain
tools.description: Return the current domain of the connected Saleor instance.
